notes: Sourced from ZeeVee's official ZyPerUHD Encoder/Decoder datasheet (rev 2021-09-02), which lists the ZyPerUHD-D decoder's exact port table and rear-panel diagram. Desktop unit, 200 x 120 x 25 mm (L x W x H) — not rack-mountable, so rackUnits omitted. USB is listed as "Dual USB 2.0, 2x USB Type A" on the decoder (host ports for connected USB peripherals/KVM-style control, common on AVoIP decoders) — modeled as bidirectional per the port-labeling convention for USB host ports. RS-232 and analog audio both use Phoenix (captive screw) terminal blocks, mapped to the "euroblock" connector id since Phoenix/detachable screw terminals aren't separately listed. Ethernet grade is 1Gb (eth-1g) per datasheet ("1 Gb RJ45 port"); HDMI grade is HDMI 2.0 (device spec states "HDMI 2.0a"). No SDI/DisplayPort ports exist on this model. The companion encoder (ZyPerUHD-E) has a different port set (HDMI in + loop-out, USB-B, balanced+unbalanced audio in/out) and is a separate SKU, not covered here since the request was specifically for the -D decoder.

ports.name: HDMI Out
ports.note: HDMI 2.0a with HDCP 2.2 pass-through; also carries multi-channel digital audio (LPCM up to 8ch, Dolby Digital, AC3)

ports.name: Media Transport (1Gb Ethernet, PoE)
ports.note: Carries compressed video/audio/control over IP; device can be powered via PoE on this port

ports.name: Audio Out
ports.note: Balanced stereo analog audio output via Phoenix/captive-screw terminal block (L+/L-/GR+/GR-)

ports.name: RS-232
ports.note: Full duplex serial up to 115.2 kbps via Phoenix terminal block (TX/RX/G) for display/source control

ports.name: USB Host
ports.note: Dual USB 2.0 Type A host ports (device has 2x USB-A per datasheet)

ports.name: Power
ports.note: 12 VDC 1A via locking barrel connector; external power supply included (can alternatively be powered via PoE on Ethernet port)
